approvalScope: approve the adapted configuration and authorize a local pilot; this does not authorize publication

pilotScope.initialPageTarget: one existing route selected after evidence review

preconditions.question: Which cities and ZIP codes are genuinely inside the current service boundary?
Is the business service-area-only, and what verified address, GBP category, hours, and license facts may be used?
What exact operational conditions control same-day availability?

stages.gate: market, audience, scope, conversion, evidence inventory, and paid-query budget explicitly recorded
each query classified by intent, buyer job, funnel, local strength, and ambiguity
raw localized SERP and fetched-source evidence stored before interpretation
merge/separate/owner-review decisions use localized overlap, buyer-job evidence, and stored SERP evidence
every proposed commercial claim mapped to fact ID, conditional rule, prohibition, or blocker
trigger, jobs, anxieties, questions, criteria, evidence needs, and outcome are ordered
promise, audience moment, thesis, differentiation, conversion, proof, and emotional rhythm are explicit
smallest sufficient block sequence passes artifact contract and contains no final copy
independent adversarial review returns zero unresolved blockers
supported value, proof, objections, risk reduction, and CTA motivation are explicit; no invented benefits or filler
every block maps to a registered content format and explicit field whitelist; final visual design is not decided here
every slot has evidence, length, terminology, claim, transition, and CTA constraints
human-first copy stays inside the passed brief and contains no unsupported or internal implementation language
controlled edits only; change log, intent, metadata, hierarchy, canonical, links, FAQ parity, schema, robots, and indexability pass; no city-frequency rule
every geographic occurrence is classified required, natural, or seo-driven; zero unclassified and zero unresolved seo-driven occurrences
post-SEO whole-page narrative, supported marketing, conversion, credibility, pacing, and natural language pass with zero critical or major findings
approved meaning and copy are implemented with coherent hierarchy, composition, spacing, typography, density, and responsive behavior

exact rendered HTML passes technical checks; ordered scroll-frame screenshot manifests exist for 4K, Full HD, tablet, and mobile; each route stores releaseHash, renderedHtmlHash, screenshotSetHash, CSS/media coverage, and policy version
independent critic reviews exact screenshots, answers whether design is genuinely good, and returns zero unresolved critical or major findings without editing
isolated reviewer receives only exact rendered experience, screenshots, persona, and task; forbidden-context manifest is empty; authorIsReviewer is false
technical geometry, hierarchy, rhythm, monotony, cross-route repetition, and adjacent data-dense surfaces pass independently
every rendered commercial claim passes canonical fact audit
all current artifacts match exact hashes; zero revise, critical, major, or blocker findings; no shared approvals
one approval record per exact route contains all immutable hashes and independent review evidence
disabled for this local pilot; requires a separate explicit publication instruction and rollback version
deferred until an explicitly approved release exists
only actual answer-engine responses from the stable prompt set are stored; no synthetic baseline
proposals use observed evidence; owner corrections enter versioned memory and conflicts are superseded

stopConditions: role silently edits another owner's work
post-SEO critical or major editorial finding
visual critic is designer or edits the page
literal or semantic internal buyer-visible language
batch wildcard inherited latest or cross-route approval
same defect on two or more URLs
any technical factual language design blind-buyer SEO or capability revise
stale policy release HTML CSS media or screenshot hash
nextActionAfterApproval: create a new pilot run ID and execute stages 1-5 locally; stop on owner-input blockers before architecture or copy
